description: Output schema from Person 3 Recovery Planner to Person 4 Operator Console

fields.decision_id: string (unique identifier for this decision step)
fields.belief_hash: string (SHA256 prefix of observation belief state)
fields.queue_cost: float (predicted integrated queue delay over horizon)
fields.spillback_cost: float (predicted penalty for queue spillback > 80% capacity)
fields.emergency_delay_s: float (predicted delay for emergency vehicles if active)
fields.rollout_ms: float (wall-clock duration of lookahead simulation in ms)
fields.selected: boolean (true if this candidate was selected for live execution)
